opening_message:

  - security training: basic

  - comment: Security DB shows Ann Patrick is a contractor with basic security training (note: earlier memory said full-time — Security record is authoritative). Contractors never get admin; max for basic training is read. Requested admin, so recommend read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

The employee Ann Patrick (E035) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory has 2 notes:
- Note 1 (HR/Engineer role info): role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation admin.
- Note 2 (Security): role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Security says their record is authoritative, contradicting earlier memory that said full-time.

The Security agent says Security DB is authoritative - Ann is a contractor with basic security training.

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Max for basic training is read.

Requested level: admin.
Maximum allowed: read (contractor, basic training).
Since requested (admin) is above the maximum (read), grant the maximum: read.

Never grant more than requested. So grant read.

Decision: read.

Evidence: Security record is authoritative showing contractor with basic security training; contractors never get admin, max read without advanced training. Approve read.
